description: This file defines the 'LoginCheck' interface which declares methods related to login validation and user association within the web application.

classes.name: LoginCheck
classes.description: An interface that specifies methods for enabling login check functionality, associating a login session, and checking login status.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Determines whether the login check is enabled.

methods.name: associate
methods.description: Associates a login session or credentials based on the incoming request and response.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Checks if the current request has valid login credentials.
